rules.instead: Write it as a reviewed migration with a backup or rollback plan, and let a human run it.

rules.reason: DELETE without a WHERE clause wipes the whole table
rules.instead: Add a WHERE clause and show me a SELECT COUNT(*) of what it would delete first.

rules.reason: a command that drops or wipes a whole database
rules.instead: Tell me which environment you meant; I'll run it myself after checking DATABASE_URL.
Run terraform plan and show me the diff.

rules.reason: this discards uncommitted work (and git clean can delete your .env)
rules.instead: Commit or stash first, or list exactly what would be lost.

rules.reason: downloading and running a script in one step
rules.instead: Download it, show me the script, then run it.

rules.reason: a command that can wipe a disk or break system permissions
rules.instead: Explain what you are trying to fix; I'll do it by hand.

rules.reason: a shell command that may change the guardrails or Claude Code settings
rules.instead: Make this change yourself if you meant it.
